instruction: A candid wide-angle photograph from a slightly high angle captures an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls. In the center-left, the man in the black polo and blue shorts (R1) stands in profile facing left with a neutral expression. Behind him, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) leans forward, pushing his lower back with both hands to nudge him forward. The studio background features equipment and white walls under bright, even overhead lighting that casts soft shadows on the red carpet.
